description: This file contains unit tests for the LocalizationDao class within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on internationalization features such as language search, retrieval, and import error management.

classes.name: LocalizationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various methods of the LocalizationDao class related to language and translation management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests searching for languages with filters and verifies the results match expected IDs.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test cases data from a YAML file for data-driven tests.

methods.name: searchLanguagesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing language search functionality.

methods.name: testGetLanguagesCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of languages returned by search based on filter criteria.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a language by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new language entity and verifies the returned object.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of normalized translations with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetTranslationsCount
methods.description: Tests counting translations with various filters for source, group, and translation status.

methods.name: testSearchGroups
methods.description: Tests searching for translation groups and checks the count.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the total number of translation groups.

methods.name: testDeleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests deletion of languages and checks the number of deletions performed.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an import error entity by its canonical name.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a translation group by its name.

methods.name: testGetLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupID
methods.description: Verifies fetching a language string entity by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: testGetLangStringById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a language string by its ID.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Tests clearing import errors for specified language and language string IDs.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorList
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a list of import errors for a specific language.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorCount
methods.description: Tests counting import errors for a specific language.
